design.title: Queue Post-Task Auto-Commit
design.summary: Add atomicCommit call in queue.ts after each queue task completes (both success and failure paths), so that QUEUE.json and HISTORY.json state changes are committed to git after every queue task execution.
design.approach: Option A — Add atomicCommit in queue.ts (minimal, targeted change)
alternatives_rejected: Option B: commit in executeTeam finalization — would duplicate per-wave commits, mixes concerns
Option C: post-task hook mechanism — over-engineered for a 10-line change

change_points.action: Add atomicCommit(this.cwd, nextTask.id, `Queue task ${freshTask.status}`) if autoCommit is enabled
change_points.rationale: Commits QUEUE.json (updated status=done) and HISTORY.json (new entry)

change_points.action: Add atomicCommit(this.cwd, nextTask.id, `Queue task failed`) if autoCommit is enabled
change_points.rationale: Commits QUEUE.json (updated status=failed, error) and HISTORY.json (failure entry)

implementation.autoCommit_respect: Read from execOptions.autoCommit (already computed at line 298). Need to hoist or re-check the option before the commit call.
implementation.import_needed: atomicCommit is already imported in queue.ts (from ./planning.js)

key_decisions.rationale: Queue state (QUEUE.json, HISTORY.json) is updated by queue.ts after executeTeam returns. This is a queue-specific concern.

key_decisions.decision: Commit on both success and failure paths
key_decisions.rationale: Failed task status is valuable state — it records what failed and why, enabling queue resume.
Consistency with existing --no-commit CLI flag. Users who disable commits should not get queue commits either.

Without taskFiles, atomicCommit stages all dirty files. Since we're post-executeTeam, the only remaining dirty files are .planning/ state files (QUEUE.json, HISTORY.json). This is exactly what we want.
Consistent with existing format '{taskId}: {message}'. Makes queue commits easily identifiable in git log.

edge_cases: executeTeam already committed everything → atomicCommit returns false (no-op), safe
No dirty files at all → atomicCommit returns false, safe
atomicCommit throws → wrapped in try/catch, log warning, don't break queue loop
design.scope: ~10 lines of code change in queue.ts + documentation updates
